newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE cocoa steady to lower, interest light.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE cocoa steady to lower, interest light.

text.p: LIFFE cocoa futures ended unchanged to down after a quiet session, with sellers and buyers staying away, traders said.
Active May last traded unchanged at 880 stg, having seen a low of 874 stg as sterling's recovery against other European currencies killed off buyer interest.
Total volume was 3,433 lots, with 1,431 in May.
A lack of origin selling helped keep the market quiet. "Most of them are into coffee, not cocoa," one trader said.
He didn't see a sharp move in the current state of the market. "There's nothing to justify a move either way just at the second," he said.
"It's been a very quiet day. There's hardly anything going on," said another trader .
